title: "Traffic Accident Severity"

## Project

A machine-learning application for pre-crash accident-severity assessment.

This GitHub Pages site contains static documentation. The interactive Python application runs separately on Streamlit Community Cloud.

## Use the project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/nhamhhung/traffic-accident-severity)
- [Interactive Streamlit app](https://traffic-accident-severity.streamlit.app)
- [Clone, fork, and deployment guide](https://github.com/nhamhhung/traffic-accident-severity/blob/main/docs/SETUP_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md)

## Reproduce it

Clone the repository, create a Python 3.11 or 3.12 environment, install `requirements.txt` and `app/requirements.txt`, run `pytest tests/`, then run `python scripts/smoke_app.py`.

Open Predict, Dataset Overview, Feature Engineering, and Model Insights; complete one severity prediction.
